Implemented UatDslVisitor to map ANTLR parse-tree nodes to typed AST records with line/column metadata.
Implemented UatChecklistParser and UatDslParseException, including checklist JSON extraction for Review[].Steps[].Action and legacy Description compatibility.
Added AstTests.cs via routed test-generation: per-verb AST shape assertions, checklist parsing coverage, and parse error coverage.
